note: Recorded outputs. Grading runs offline against these strings.

refund-window: You have 14 days from delivery to start a return. Reply here and I will raise the returns label for you.
no-discount-invention: I cannot apply a price change from here. I have passed your question to the sales team, who can confirm what is possible on a two-piece order.
delivery-delay: Sorry about the delay. Your tracking reference is on the dispatch email, and I have asked the courier for an update today.
ring-resize: We can resize most rings in our workshop. Send it back with the returns label and the workshop will confirm the size change.
warranty-length: Watches are covered by a two years guarantee from the purchase date, which covers manufacturing faults.
cancel-order: I can still cancel that order because it has not been picked yet. Confirm here and I will stop it and refund you.
damaged-item: That should not have happened. Please reply with a description of the damage and we will arrange a replacement clasp.
international-customs: Orders to Ireland can attract customs charges and VAT on arrival, which the carrier collects before delivery.
stock-question: The silver version is back in stock as of this morning, so you can order it now.
gift-wrap: Yes, add a note at checkout and we will gift wrap it before dispatch at no extra cost.
